messages:
mara: Proposal: start server-side soft-route from /v1/generate -> /v2/generate next Tue but only after console preview is ready. want quick feedback on billing & telemetry.
jonathan: Important: billing needs traceability. If we bill as v2 people will complain.
ash: Current pipeline bills to destination. thats why migrations look like a cost jump.
sam: Suggestion: emit origin_version=v1 and routed_version=v2 on usage events so we can attribute both.
tess-ux: UX: "Upgrade Preview" modal that shows 7d baseline tokens, est tokens on v2, est $ delta, and a small compatibility score. also list top affected tenants.
mara: Technical: router should set header X-Redwood-Origin-Version when automatic routing happens; middleware keeps it through proxies to billing pings.
ash: Add metric compat.silent_routed_count (by route/tenant) and compat.routed_token_delta.
jonathan: Routing precedence: honor client explicit prefer_version header, then console pins, then auto-route. older SDKs pinned to v1 must not be auto-routed.
sam: Privacy: headers land in logs. TTL + tenant opt-out. billing will use origin_version only for reporting, not to expose raw headers.
mara: Rollout: dry-run -> 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automated rollback on p95 latency +25% OR token_per_request +30% OR error_rate +0.5% abs.
deploy-bot: (system) queued: canary-run 1768800001, will post results here.
ash: Owners: jonathan infra headers + metrics, sam billing ingestion, tess-ux modal + heatmap, ash router tests. dry-run preview by EOD Fri?
all: SGTM.
